title: Who did this?
notes: The heart of the recap, governed by the discretion rule (CAPTAIN.md 2). She has
known since 9 July what her exobiologist worked out. Until `truth` holds she declines
honestly and the question stays on the list; the sandbox's Captain tells the truth
decides what it takes. Tier T is the only place in her tree the Changeling is named,
and gen_captain.py refuses the word anywhere its tier does not wait on `truth`.

lines.text: Somebody cut our engines in February and went away.
In June the county below us died in two days.
We were never the target. We were the witnesses.
They blinded us first, so nobody would see it done.

options.text: Who do your people think it was?
Who do your people think it was?

lines.text: Two, aboard, and sensible people hold both.
Section 31. That was Shepard's, and she argued it well.
Or somebody on this ship, for reasons of their own.
That second one is the one that keeps me walking the decks.
Shepard's case: a hidden posting, a Federation bioweapon on file.
Section 31 has done this kind of thing before. It's on record.
I don't rule it out. I don't put my name to it either.
She considers you for a long moment.
My exobiologist has a theory. I've read it. I've signed nothing.
It names a suspect I can't prove, and it would frighten people.
Shepard's logs are on the shelf in her shuttle. Watch all six.
You've spoken to Commander Okafor. So you know what he is.
He told me what he told you. They were blindsided too.
I believe him. He had every reason to lie and didn't bother.
Which leaves us with nobody. That's worse.
I heard. He said you were thorough.
From Okafor that's a compliment. Don't expect another.
All right. Here is what my people think. I think they're right.
One of the Changelings left the Great Link, on purpose.
It knew what Section 31 did to its people. The virus.
It spent sixty years alone, turning that into something else.
The Founders' virus to break a body down.
Borg nanoprobes to put it back together and keep it moving.
No Queen. Nothing telling it what it's for.
What walks down there is a Collective with no Queen.
The Doctor could only read half of it. There are two halves.
Because this world is a copy of Earth, and nobody guards it.
Same bodies. Same towns. A rehearsal.
When she goes on, her voice is flatter.
What comes after Kentucky is the Federation.
We were told not to interfere. It read the same order we did.
